text:
sara: Heads up — VividLogix renewal ~6w out but usage dropped ~65% over the last 2 weeks. Procurement running a competitive eval with CloudMason and there's a new PM (Lucas) on the account. Seen on our console: https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/vividlogix/usage

omar: Ack. Do we have the renewal date + current ARR and who the exec sponsor is?

sara: Renewal date 2026-05-15. ARR $240k. Champion (Maya Chen, VP Eng) still listed but she moved teams last month — no exec sponsor surfaced yet.

priya: Did onboarding finish? Any known quality regressions or config changes that could explain the drop?

jonathan: Quick check of infra logs — saw a burst of 429s and latency spikes starting 2026-03-09. Paste:```
2026-03-10T14:03:22Z ERROR rate_limiter reject req_id=abc123 status=429 avg_latency_ms=1200
2026-03-10T14:03:23Z WARN kvcache miss ratio=0.72
```

sara: Good catch. They also started a reranking pilot with CloudMason on 3/8 per notes from account — could be routing + token usage changes.

omar: Can we get a 30-min triage with VividLogix + Lucas + Maya (if available) this week? I'll join. Need to confirm win themes and any licensing/benchmarks CloudMason is promising.

priya: I can prepare: last-60-day usage heatmap, top 10 prompts and error breakdown + short runbook for rollback. Available Thu 10:00-11:30 or Fri 09:00-12:00 PT.

jonathan: I'll collect kernel/runtime metrics (latency by seq len, 429s, cache hit %) and a short slide on mitigations (increase concurrency, temp token limits, enable prefix caching).

alisa-bot: Calendar invite created: VividLogix renewal triage — Thu 2026-03-12 10:30 PT — sara, omar, priya, jonathan, Lucas(vividlogix).ics

omar: Thanks. Priorities for the call: confirm decision timeline, clarify CloudMason eval criteria, present quick performance check and rollback options.

sara: I'll DM Lucas to get any deck they're using so we can counter their claims on cost/latency. Leaving action items in the thread. :thumbsup:
